entries.title: The fleet looks for a way around blocked work
entries.body: Your first mate tries available solutions before asking you. When it needs another view, a read-only crewmate looks for alternatives. When a task stays stuck, its card says what the task still waits on and what your first mate already tried.

picture.alt: A stuck task's card saying what the task still waits on and the one attempt the first mate recorded to get around it
